title: Atlas Crossing Partners | Pinecrest Foods | LBO Model — Overview
summary: Full LBO model for Pinecrest Foods (Atlas Crossing Partners Fund III), entered September 2020 at a 12.5× EV/EBITDA entry multiple ($168.75M entry EV) on $13.5M LTM EBITDA and $65.4M LTM revenue. Capital structure includes $74.25M senior TL (5.5×), $20.25M sub/mezz PIK at 11.5% (1.5×), and $74.25M Atlas equity (44%). An add-on acquisition of Harvest Ridge Snacks closed Q2 2023 for ~$38M. Base case projects exit in FY2027E at 11.0× EV/EBITDA on $28.6M EBITDA, implying a $314.6M exit EV, 2.86× gross MOIC, and ~16.2% gross IRR over a 7-year hold (~13.0% net IRR / ~2.35× net MOIC). The model includes a full income statement with actuals through FY2025A and estimates through FY2027E, a detailed debt schedule, and a multi-scenario MOIC/IRR sensitivity matrix.

growth_drivers: Organic revenue growth from ~$65M at entry to ~$162M at exit
Add-on acquisition of Harvest Ridge Snacks (~$38M, Q2 2023) driving inorganic revenue scale
Gross margin stability at 44% throughout hold period
Debt paydown via mandatory amortization and 50% excess cash flow sweep
risks: EBITDA margin compression from 20.6% at entry to 17.6% at projected exit
High entry leverage of 7.1× Debt/EBITDA; PIK debt accreting from $20.25M to $48.4M by exit
Total net debt growing to $102.0M at exit despite cash flow sweep
Negative/near-zero unlevered FCF in FY2020A; capital-intensive model with heavy capex
